nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set in the Ownable constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Human readable oracle name constant stored on-chain.
Oracle type/ticker identifier stored on-chain.
Timestamp of the last oracle update request, written with block.timestamp.
Timestamp of the last oracle callback, written with block.timestamp.
Address of the bank/finance contract allowed to request rate updates.
Latest ETHUSD rate delivered by the oracle callback.
Price in wei the updater wallet must hold to accept a query.
Flag indicating an oracle query is pending a callback.
Address of the oracle updater wallet that receives funding and signs callbacks.
Constructor that initializes the owner with msg.sender.
Owner-only function transferring ownership to newOwner.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == bankAddress.
Owner-only function setting the bank address.
Owner-only function setting the updater address.
View function returning the required request price based on updater balance.
Owner-only function setting the request price in wei.
Bank-only function emitting a new query event and arming the waitQuery flag.
Oracle callback that verifies the caller is the updater and waitQuery is set before writing the rate.
Payable fallback forwarding all received value to the updater wallet.
Caller controlled address used for owner init, ownership check and bank/updater checks.
Miner influenced timestamp used for updateTime and callbackTime.
Writes owner = msg.sender in the constructor, giving privileged control to the deployer.
Writes owner = newOwner, a privileged control transfer.
Writes bankAddress, an unvalidated privileged authorization target.
Writes updaterAddress, the address authorized to submit oracle callbacks and receive funds.
Writes requestPrice, controlling oracle query funding requirements.
Writes updateTime = now and waitQuery = true, a timestamp dependent state transition.
Writes rate = result and callbackTime = now, a timestamp dependent privileged state transition.
External value transfer updaterAddress.transfer(msg.value) in the payable fallback.
Destination address of the ownership transfer.
New bank address supplied to setBank.
New updater address supplied to setUpdaterAddress.
New request price in wei supplied to setPrice.
Oracle supplied rate value delivered to __callback.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner privileged state variable.
The assignment operation writes the owner state variable.
The newOwner parameter flows into the ownership assignment.
The ownership assignment updates the owner state variable.
The bank parameter flows into the bankAddress assignment.
The assignment updates the bankAddress privileged state variable.
The updater parameter flows into the updaterAddress assignment.
The assignment updates the updaterAddress privileged state variable.
The _requestPriceWei parameter flows into the requestPrice assignment.
The assignment updates the requestPrice state variable.
The oracle result parameter flows into the rate assignment.
The callback write updates the rate state variable.
block.timestamp is stored into updateTime, a miner manipulable dependency.
The timestamp dependent write updates the updateTime state variable.
block.timestamp is stored into callbackTime inside the callback.
The timestamp dependent write updates the callbackTime state variable.
The fallback sends value to updaterAddress, an externally controlled recipient.
getPrice reads updaterAddress.balance to decide the returned price.
The Ownable constructor executes the owner initialization.
transferOwnership executes the ownership assignment.
The onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership.
setBank executes the bankAddress assignment.
The onlyOwner modifier guards setBank.
setUpdaterAddress executes the updaterAddress assignment.
The onlyOwner modifier guards setUpdaterAddress.
setPrice executes the requestPrice assignment.
The onlyOwner modifier guards setPrice.
updateRate writes updateTime and waitQuery.
The onlyBank modifier guards updateRate.
__callback executes the rate and callbackTime writes.
The fallback executes the external value transfer to the updater.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner for authorization.
onlyBank compares msg.sender against bankAddress for authorization.
__callback requires msg.sender to equal updaterAddress.
__callback requires the waitQuery flag to be true.
The external transfer to updaterAddress can re-enter the payable fallback before completion.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter only exists to feed the transferOwnership ownership assignment and has no standalone semantics.
The bank parameter is only used inside setBank to set bankAddress.
The updater parameter is only used inside setUpdaterAddress to set updaterAddress.
The _requestPriceWei parameter is only used inside setPrice to set requestPrice.
The result parameter is the oracle supplied value consumed by the __callback rate update.
